summary: Founder triage resolves its destination pool and the parked pool by title prefix against the open milestones at run time, instead of hard-coding a milestone number that a backlog re-pool retires.
reader_impact: A maintainer can run `pnpm triage:founder` again: a founder issue lands in `v2.2.0 — the member surface` and a parked one in `v2.deferred` at whatever numbers those pools carry, and a pool that is gone stops the run by name.
